Restored as row 1 on 2026-10-24: the live KIE catalog DOES carry minimax-h3/image-to-video, so the 2026-10-21 removal under the claim that it never did was wrong. ultra._doc: F-QM-4: the Ultra row is its own entry, not a numbered vendor option, so the four numbered rows and their answer-index mapping never move. Ultra renders 4K and is shown only when a live registry model advertises 4K pricing; otherwise ultra_model() returns ULTRA_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE and the card shows it as unavailable -- never a lower-resolution substitute.
